sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "It's good that you're alive, tasks from Sniper are not easy. Let's wait for a little before the next test. There is going to be a lot more complicated sniper work from now on, so my advice is that you master your bolt-action rifle handling skills some more. Come back when you're ready."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate any 15 targets with a bolt-action rifle

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Mosin Rifle ATI Monte Carlo stock
- Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle ATI Monte Carlo stock at Jaeger LL3
- Unlocks craft for 7.62x54mm R BT gzh at Workbench level 3
"Ready? Then let’s get to work. Sniper took a big interest in you."
